comments.author: Nour
comments.body: Does anyone know how to obtain this please?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Complete any Legacy discovery related to the Calculators Legacy (unlocked by completing the Legacy TH3. Precise Artillery Calculator quest) and you will receive this item. I believe the upcoming update's Aroma/Perfume Legacy will also drop this item.

This guide will be helpful to those seeking to do the Calculator Legacy: forum.papayaplay.com/discussion/1795/legacy-3-worlds-calculators#latest

Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.
